sentiment.guide_what_is: Sentiment analysis measures how AI systems (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude) perceive your brand — positive, neutral, or negative. Hallucination detection flags factual errors in AI responses about your brand.
sentiment.guide_how_it_works: Every time a monitoring check runs, a secondary AI analyzes each engine response and extracts sentiment and hallucination data. The results shown here are aggregated from all your monitoring runs.
sentiment.guide_what_to_do: To get started, run monitoring checks from the Prompts page. Use the Manual Analyzer below to test individual AI responses. Track trends over time via the Snapshots page.
sentiment.guide_sentiment_value: Sentiment feeds into your AVI score (15% weight) and GEO Score trust pillar. A positive score improves your overall AI visibility ranking.
sentiment.guide_hallucination_value: Hallucination rate affects your AVI score (10% weight — anti-hallucination component). Lower is better. Investigate flagged claims to ensure AI systems represent your brand accurately.
sentiment.guide_industry_terms: This analysis uses standard industry terminology: AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), and LLM SEO — based on the Bertram glossary (CC BY 4.0) and Kalyani Khona's LLM behavior research.
sentiment.guide_footer_disclaimer: Recommendations are based on OBSERVED BEHAVIORAL PATTERNS, not guaranteed outcomes. AI model behavior can change without notice.
sentiment.scope_hint: Questions that already name the brand are answered with a mention almost every time and in a neutral-to-positive tone — the competitive signal lives in the discovery questions.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about AI visibility monitoring.

items.a: AVI is a proprietary 0-100 score combining 6 weighted factors: citation rate (20%), mention frequency (20%), recommendation rate (20%), sentiment score (15%), position average (15%), and hallucination index (10%). Higher scores mean better visibility across AI-generated responses.

Enter your domain and up to 3 competitors. Our engine orchestrates parallel queries to ChatGPT/SearchGPT, Google Gemini, Perplexity AI, and Claude, then aggregates results into a unified dashboard with per-engine breakdowns and trend analysis.

items.q: Which AI engines and models are supported?
items.a: ChatGPT (web + GPTs + SearchGPT), Google Gemini (web + Advanced), Perplexity AI, Claude (web), and Google AI Overviews. Analysis models include Gemini 2.5 Flash/Pro, GPT-4o/4o-mini, Claude Sonnet 4.5/Haiku 4.5, and Perplexity Sonar.

items.q: How often is my data refreshed?
items.a: Daily automated scans for all active subscriptions, with configurable alert rules for new mentions, lost mentions, sentiment drops, positive spikes, competitor lead changes, and hallucination detection.
Yes — start with a free single audit that covers your domain across all supported engines. No credit card required. Full dashboards, competitor comparison, and exportable reports are included.

items.q: What is the difference between AIO, AEO, and GEO?
items.a: AIO (AI Optimization) optimizes content for AI model discoverability. AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) targets direct answers and featured snippets. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) optimizes for AI-generated search results. Our platform covers all three with dedicated tools and scoring.
Yes, we analyze visibility across 50+ languages. AI models respond differently per language — our platform tracks those variations and provides language-specific insights in your reports.

Google Search Console sync (branded search, striking distance keywords, cannibalization detection), public REST API v1 with webhooks, Obsidian export, and custom report scheduling with automated PDF/CSV/JSON delivery.

Three tiers: Pro at $49/month (individuals and small teams), Business at $199/month (teams with full features), Agency at $499/month (multi-brand agencies). Annual plans include a 20% discount. 14-day money-back guarantee on all plans.

items.q: What kind of support do you offer?
items.a: All plans include email support with 24-hour response. Business includes live chat, Agency includes a dedicated account manager with priority phone support. Technical documentation and API reference are available for all users.

geo_dashboard.methodology_body: Answer Position was being scored on the wrong scale: it measures which sentence first names your brand, but was normalised as if it were a 1–5 search ranking, so anything from the fifth sentence on scored zero. Scores have shifted as a result. This is a correction to how the score is calculated, not a change in how visible your brand is.
geo_dashboard.page_subtitle: Generative Engine Optimization — how well your brand is optimized to be surfaced and cited by AI answer engines.
geo_dashboard.no_score_hint: Run the monitoring cron to generate brand health scores. The GEO score is derived from your AI visibility metrics over time.
geo_dashboard.breakdown_hint: Each pillar is weighted; its contribution sums to the total score.

geo_dashboard.grade_scale_tail: Each category score (0–100) is multiplied by its weight; the weighted points sum to your total.
geo_dashboard.improve_title: How to improve your GEO Score
geo_dashboard.improve_hint: Ordered by impact — the number on each card is the points you'd recover if that pillar reached 100 (its gap × its weight). Start at the top.

geo_dashboard.desc_citation: How often AI engines cite your domain as a source — the strongest GEO signal.
geo_dashboard.desc_presence: How often your brand is mentioned at all in AI answers.
geo_dashboard.desc_authority: How often the brand is actively recommended, not merely named.
geo_dashboard.desc_position: Where your brand appears in the answer (earlier = more visible).
geo_dashboard.desc_trust: Sentiment toward the brand combined with factual accuracy (low hallucination).
geo_dashboard.why_citation: Citations are the strongest GEO signal and the highest-weighted pillar (30%): when an engine links your domain as a source you gain both visibility AND trust, so gains here move the score the most.
geo_dashboard.why_presence: Presence is the foundation — if the model never names you, no other pillar can help. It is the second-heaviest pillar (25%).
geo_dashboard.why_authority: Being mentioned is good; being recommended is what converts. Models recommend brands that have social proof and clear comparison context.
geo_dashboard.why_position: Where you appear in the answer decides whether users actually notice you. A low/zero score means you are effectively never positioned, even when mentioned.
geo_dashboard.why_trust: Negative sentiment or hallucinations make models describe you inaccurately or steer users away — that caps the upside of every other pillar.
geo_dashboard.action_citation_1: Publish fact-dense, well-structured pages models can quote (clear claims, data, dates).
geo_dashboard.action_citation_2: Add a clean llms.txt + schema.org markup so engines have a citable, machine-readable source.
geo_dashboard.action_citation_3: Earn citations on high-authority third-party sites the engines already trust.
geo_dashboard.action_presence_1: Broaden topical coverage around your category and the problems you solve.
geo_dashboard.action_presence_2: Make sure your brand name + aliases appear in canonical, crawlable content.
geo_dashboard.action_presence_3: Build a Wikipedia presence — roughly 48% of ChatGPT citations come from Wikipedia.
geo_dashboard.action_authority_1: Create comparison and "best of" pages that position you against named alternatives.
geo_dashboard.action_authority_2: Earn reviews and third-party mentions that models read as endorsements.
geo_dashboard.action_authority_3: Engage authentically on Reddit — roughly 47% of Perplexity citations come from Reddit.
geo_dashboard.action_position_1: Lead key pages with a concise, direct answer (answer-first format).
geo_dashboard.action_position_2: Use clear headings and Q&A blocks the model can lift verbatim.
geo_dashboard.action_position_3: Keep the most important facts in the first 100 words of the page.
geo_dashboard.action_trust_1: Correct outdated or wrong facts on your site and in third-party sources.
geo_dashboard.action_trust_2: Strengthen structured data (Organization, Product) so models describe you precisely.
geo_dashboard.action_trust_3: Publish an authoritative About page with verifiable, dated claims.
